info.title: Human Digital Twin (HDT) Clearance API
info.description: Research prototype for uncertainty-aware 3D clearance analysis.

get.description: Return the registry of all body systems (available and planned).

schema.title: Response List Systems Body Systems Get

post.description:
Build and return the 3-D primitive items for *system_id*.

Parameters
----------
system_id : str
    One of the available system IDs (skeleton, vascular, organs).
body : BodyParams
    Anthropometric body model supplied in the request body.

Returns
-------
SystemItemsResponse
    JSON-serialisable list of BodyItem dicts.

Raises
------
404 : system_id not found or not available
422 : body params fail anatomical validation

BodyParams.title: BodyParams
BodyParams.description:
Body Explorer 3D human stature and skeletal joint parameters.

Coordinate system:
  - Units: Millimetres (mm).
  - Axes: RAS (x toward person's right, y anterior, z superior).
  - Origin (0, 0, 0): Situated on the floor plane directly between the feet.
  - Person stands erect facing +y.
  - "l_" corresponds to person's own left (x < 0).
  - "r_" corresponds to person's own right (x > 0).
